description:
POWERFUL 500W MOTOR - The efficient motor delivers smooth acceleration and a top speed of up to 19 MPH for neighborhood trips, commuting, and daily errands. It can handle climbing slopes of up to 15 degrees under suitable riding conditions.

36V 10.4AH HIGH-CAPACITY BATTERY - Travel up to 25 miles on a full charge, with an estimated charging time of approximately 5 hours. Actual range may vary based on rider weight, speed, terrain, incline, temperature, and riding habits.

FRONT & REAR DETACHABLE BASKETS - Two spacious cargo baskets provide convenient storage for groceries, shopping bags, backpacks, and other everyday essentials. The removable design makes loading, unloading, and cleaning easier.

COMFORTABLE SEATED RIDING - The large cushioned saddle supports a relaxed riding position, while front and rear suspension help absorb bumps and road vibration. Durable 12-inch tires provide stable traction across pavement, grass, and other firm surfaces.

265 LB CAPACITY & COMMUTER FEATURES - The reinforced frame supports riders weighing up to 265 pounds. A bright front headlight, wide foot platform, fenders, responsive braking system, and kickstand provide added convenience for everyday use. Always wear appropriate protective equipment and follow local riding regulations.
